_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/decentraland/governance-ui/main/src/pages/submit/index.tsx (category groups + order + onClick/href behavior), src/types/proposals.ts (ProposalType/PoiType/HiringType/CatalystType enums), src/utils/locations.ts (submit() route slug = /submit/<type-with-dashes>), and the ui3 GvSubmitProposal COPY block (verbatim governance-ui i18n category.*_title / *_description / page.submit.*). Governance is NOT a Catalyst service (DAO runs on Snapshot + Aragon), so this is a SIMULATED/derived fixture; the upstream governance repo paths 404 (the live source is decentraland/governance-ui).
